label: User Registered
description: Fires when a new user account is created. Good for welcome messages.

label: User Verified
description: Fires when a user successfully verifies their email or netmail address.

label: Password Reset Completed
description: Fires when a user successfully changes their password via the reset flow.

label: Unverified Purge Warning
description: Fires N days before an unverified account is auto-purged. Days configurable.

label: First Login
description: Fires on a user's first successful login (logoncount increments to 1).

label: Nth Login Milestone
description: Fires when login count hits a milestone (10, 100, 1000, etc). Template conditions can specify which counts.

label: Login Anniversary
description: Fires daily for users whose firstlogon date matches today (1 year, 2 years, etc).

label: Account Anniversary
description: Fires daily for users whose created_at date matches today.

label: Birthday
description: Fires daily for users whose birthdate matches today. Requires birthdate on file.

label: Dormant User
description: Fires daily for users who haven't logged in within N days. Days configurable per template via conditions.

label: First Message Post
description: Fires the first time a user posts a message to any area.

label: Nth Message Post Milestone
description: Fires when a user's post count hits a milestone (100, 500, 1000, etc). Counts configurable via template conditions.

label: First File Upload
description: Fires the first time a user uploads a file.

label: Nth File Upload Milestone
description: Fires when a user's upload count hits a milestone. Counts configurable via template conditions.

label: QWK API Fetch
description: Fires on each API-authenticated QWK download or REP upload. Useful for 'since you last checked in' messages or opt-in engagement tracking. Does not fire for browser web QWK downloads or terminal QWK transfers.
